data_fields.name: max_steps_per_frame
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 written as 3/60 s = 50 ms (= 6 ticks at 120 Hz; the donor comment says 3 substeps)

data_fields.name: network_debt_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: int, signed; positive adds steps now, negative removes and carries (no caller found)

best_idea: A fixed physics tick fed by an accumulator, capped per frame in ticks (not ms), so a stalled tab slows the shown time instead of replaying the missed steps.
decision_why: Take the accumulator, the tick-counted cap and the vsync-aware throttle; do not copy the networked exemption from the cap, and do not put any time dilation on the server, because Frankendom kills are server-verified.
acceptance: A fake-clock test with a 2 s gap runs at most 3 fight steps in the frame after the gap and the frames after it, and the fight visibly slows rather than skipping; a server test asserts the server step count is unaffected by the client frame cap.
